# Generated by "Claude files/tools/build_obsidian_tech.py". Change the tables there and re-run.
# Obsidian technology (17 November 2026). Additive hooks: they merge with the other files' on-actions.

on_monthly_pulse = {
	if = {	# the Legion's arsenal comes within the first year of the invasion
		limit = {
			tag = H94
			is_at_war = yes
			NOT = { has_global_flag = fallen_dwarf_end }
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_OBS_arsenal_queued }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_OBS_arsenal_queued
		country_event = { id = DA_OBS.1 days = 1 random = 330 }
	}
}

on_yearly_pulse = {
	if = {	# the victory over the invasion outlives the Obsidian Breaker modifier (100 years)
		limit = {
			has_country_modifier = onyx_breaker
			NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_OBS_invasion_defeated }
		}
		set_country_flag = DA_OBS_invasion_defeated
	}
}
